files.name: ShelterClimbOut.java

help: Climb out of a covered shelter shaft: mine the lid, pillar up or dig steps until a side is open
lesson: The shelter exit failed because StairUp needed a block to fill a step; a climb-out that pillars when it has blocks and otherwise digs a step staircase needs no placements to succeed.
summary: shelter_climb_out: after shelter fails STUCK (morning, couldn't climb out of the covered shaft), mine the lid and pillar up with blocks, or carve a blockless staircase, until a side is open.
